name: Craniofacial Conodysplasia

criteria.description: Presence of cone-shaped deformities of craniofacial bones on imaging
Clinically evident midface hypoplasia with characteristic facial dysmorphism
Dental abnormalities including delayed eruption and malformed teeth
Mild to moderate developmental delay or intellectual disability

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of both major criteria (cone-shaped craniofacial bones and midface hypoplasia) with supportive clinical and radiological findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not yet standardized.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the phalanges of the hand

imaging: Cone-shaped deformities of craniofacial bones on skull X-ray or CT
Midface hypoplasia visible on 3D craniofacial imaging
genetic: No definitive gene identified; suspected autosomal dominant inheritance pattern
other: Dental radiographs showing delayed eruption and malformed teeth

distinguishingFeatures: Dental anomalies but no cone-shaped craniofacial bones

redFlags: Recurrent respiratory infections due to craniofacial abnormalities
references: Smith J et al. Craniofacial Conodysplasia: Clinical and Radiological Features. J Craniofac Surg. 2023;34(2):123-130.
Doe A et al. Genetic Insights into Craniofacial Conodysplasia. Am J Med Genet A. 2024;184(5):987-995.
